risk_factors: This means ExxonMobil’s operations and earnings may be significantly affected by changes in oil, gas, and petrochemical prices and by changes in margins on refined products.
Oil, gas, petrochemical, and product prices and margins in turn depend on local, regional, and global events or conditions that affect supply and demand for the relevant commodity or product.

Any material decline in oil or natural gas prices could have a material adverse effect on the Company’s operations, results, financial condition, and proved reserves, especially in the Upstream segment.

On the other hand, a material increase in oil or natural gas prices could have a material adverse effect on the Company’s operations and results, especially in the Energy Products, Chemical Products, and Specialty Products segments.

Risks Related to Our Industry Our operating results, our ability to execute on our strategy and the carrying value of our assets are exposed to the effects of volatile commodity prices or prolonged periods of low commodity prices.
Among the most significant factors impacting our revenues, operating results and future rate of growth are the sales prices for crude oil, bitumen, LNG, natural gas and NGLs.
